comment: One production branch per part (docs/operations/production-branches.md). `branch: false`: no branch is kept any more, the part only defines the images built from main (Coolify runs the images; the branches were retired 2026-11-25). `checks`: GitHub checks that must have passed on the commit, besides CI summary, before the branch changes. `paths` are relative to `base` (an entry {"from": ..., "to": ...} puts that folder somewhere else in the branch, so a Coolify setting that names a path keeps working) (default 'Caller Whale CRM'); a branch holds only those, at those paths, plus .gitignore. `rust: true` adds the Cargo workspace file, cut down to the members present, and Cargo.lock (`rust: "<folder>"`: from and to that folder). The web apps, the services (step 50+51, with packages/go) and the desktop app use `base: ""` (the repository layout, apps/ since step 52), so their branches carry the npm workspace: the root package.json, its lock file and packages/ (D383, step 49); the desktop branch carries the root Rust workspace whole. `images`: the container images built from the branch's files (.github/workflows/images.yml, step 47): `context` and `dockerfile` are paths in the branch; `buildArgs` maps a build argument to the repository's Actions variable that holds it.

components.name: website-production
components.title: Website (apps/website, callerwhale.com)
components.build: npm ci at the repository root (npm workspaces), then npm run build in apps/website. The image is built in GitHub Actions from this branch's files with the branch root as the context (images.yml); set VITE_CALLERWHALE_AUTH_URL as a build variable (env/landing-web.production.example)

components.name: crm-web-production
components.title: CRM web app (apps/crm-web, app.callerwhale.com): the desktop frontend built for the browser
components.build: The image is built in GitHub Actions from this branch's files with the branch root as the context (images.yml): Dockerfile apps/crm-web/Dockerfile, port 8080, health /healthz, build args VITE_CALLERWHALE_AUTH_URL, VITE_CALLERWHALE_API_URL and VITE_CALLERWHALE_MESSAGING_URL
